act1_low_orbit.title: First Shift
act1_low_orbit.beat: Opening: Ade jokes about the debris, Kit asks what the Corps pays in. Even the Corps lost the names of its own kit.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Dressing for orbit? Cute. Do try to breathe.

commsBefore.text: ok ok ok, the debris field is a stale buffet.
Wait, why are we catching words? What does the Corps pay in?
In words, Kit. Eventually. Shape first.
Even our own kit lost its names. Start with what you wear.
Catcher, tap a tile you need. The line pulls it in. Fill the slots before the clock runs out.

commsAfter.text: Good catch. Your tether is a little eager. It will learn manners.
Suit on, gloves sealed, and the air smells of metal. For science, I like it.
ok ok ok, my glove smells like a sandwich. Nobody touch it.

act1_low_orbit.title: The Scriptorium
act1_low_orbit.beat: Rhee's desk in the Scriptorium: she files each restored word on a handwritten card.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: A tidy corner. I bet you label your socks.

commsBefore.text: Come in, Catcher. This is my corner of the Scriptorium.
Wait, why does it look so bare?
Because a few things that held it together are lost. Find them. Shape first.

commsAfter.text: A card for each word, in my own hand. I file them so none go missing.
ok ok ok, the lamp is back on. Rhee, your desk is very tidy.
Hm. The lamp stays on. I like to see what I write.

act1_low_orbit.title: Hull Sweet Hull
act1_low_orbit.beat: Mid: bread, home, door done. Kit asks how Rhee knows the shapes; Rhee: I wrote them down.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Hull sweet hull. How domestic. I almost envy you.

commsBefore.text: Small words, but they hold a whole house together. Treat them kindly.

commsAfter.text: ok ok ok, bread. Real bread, behind a real door. I want to go home.
Rhee, how do you know what each one looks like? You never look them up.
I wrote them down. Many times. Next target, please.

act1_low_orbit.title: Thieves on the Wing
act1_low_orbit.beat: Babel's thief drones appear and go for Rhee's records. Rhee hums while she works (foreshadowing 1).
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Your records are lovely. Shame if they flew away.

commsBefore.text: Those are my records. Everything I wrote down is kept there. Babel wants them.
Wait, why are those little drones flying at us?
They carry off tiles you need. Tap a drone and the tether frees the tile.

commsAfter.text: The book is back on its shelf and the box is shut. ok ok ok, they got nothing.
Is that humming? It is slow, and it keeps stopping. For science, what is the song?
Hm. Was I humming? Habit. Keep going.

act1_low_orbit.title: Through the Scope
act1_low_orbit.beat: First sight of Tomas through the Scriptorium scope: a boy at a dark window, a radio with its light off.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Looking at something you cannot reach? I know the feeling.

commsBefore.text: Look through the Scriptorium scope, Catcher. Earth. A boy, alone in a dark room.
Wait, there are people down there?
One, at least. He needs three things to see and to hear. Go slowly.

commsAfter.text: A boy, a window, a radio with no light. For science, I want to know why.
The window is dark. The radio is ___. I have a candle. Is anyone ___?
Hm. I know that street.

act1_low_orbit.title: Small Hours
act1_low_orbit.beat: Rest: small things in the boy's room at night.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Quiet, finally. Do not get used to it.

commsBefore.text: A calm one. The boy's room, in the small hours. Three quiet things, and none of them bite.

commsAfter.text: Warm milk by the bed, a cat on the quilt. ok ok ok, I live there now.
Is the cat his? For science, I need to know.
Hm. Cats choose their people.

act1_low_orbit.title: A Note by Night
act1_low_orbit.beat: Mid: the boy tries to write to his gran. Tomas's first half-empty message.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Writing to someone? How brave. How pointless.

commsBefore.text: The boy is trying to write to someone. He needs three small things. The decoys look alike, so check every tile.

commsAfter.text: A stamp! Somebody still posts things. I love this boy.
Gran. I have a pen and paper. I ___ to tell ___ about the ___.
Hm. Keep going. Please.

act1_low_orbit.title: Dinner for Four
act1_low_orbit.beat: Core: first four-word level. The boy's family table; one chair always empty.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Four courses. Try not to drop the soup.

commsBefore.text: ok ok ok, four words at once, and it is dinner time. Nobody sit down.
The boy's family eats together. Set the scene, Catcher.

commsAfter.text: The table, the plate, the spoon. One chair always stays empty.
Wait, why does one chair stay empty? Who is missing?
Hm. That is not mine to say yet. Keep going.

act1_low_orbit.title: Getting Ready
act1_low_orbit.beat: Core: faster drift. The boy gets ready to go out.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Mind the corridor. Things get fast in here.

commsBefore.text: He is getting ready to leave. Help him get ready. Take it slowly.

commsAfter.text: The mirror gave me a stern look. The jacket is two sizes too big.
Wait, he has the key to the door. He is going out alone?
Hm. It is late for a boy to be out.

act1_low_orbit.title: Green Patch
act1_low_orbit.beat: Rest: an old garden on his way. A breath before the end.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Green things, how nice. I wonder who planted them.

commsBefore.text: Green, for once. Leaves, roots, fruit. I want all three, for science. Take your time.

commsAfter.text: A tree with an apple on it. ok ok ok, I will guard that apple with my life.
Hm. I used to keep a garden. Never mind. Good work, Catcher.

act1_low_orbit.title: Lost and Found
act1_low_orbit.beat: Late: the drones grow bolder and Babel grows louder; the boy follows the signs. Rhee warns, short.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Lost something? My drones found it first.

commsBefore.text: The boy is walking now. Four things are guiding him.
The drones are circling. One looked at my sandwich. ok ok ok, it is fine.
Short warning. Babel is louder, and the drones are bolder. Tap fast.

commsAfter.text: Road, sign, map, phone. He follows them like breadcrumbs.
ok ok ok, I would have lost the map in a minute.
Hm. I know where that road goes.

act1_low_orbit.title: The Crossing
act1_low_orbit.beat: Encounter: the drones crowd in. Closing: the boy reaches the river and says water.
act1_low_orbit.babelIntro: Almost across. My drones are feeling brave tonight.

commsBefore.text: Last one for this ring. Tap fast, and the line will hold.
ok ok ok, the drones are doing laps. I am calm. I am a very calm person holding a very loud snack.

commsAfter.text: He crossed the bridge, and the river stayed calm. He even skipped a stone.
That is the ring clear. A message just came through.
Water. I can say water.

act2_nebula.title: Pink Gas
act2_nebula.beat: Opening: the crew's wonder. Kit asks if the pink gas is normal; Ade: do not touch the pink.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Pink gas. Pretty. I see you looking at it.

commsBefore.text: The gas is pink. Is that normal?
ok ok ok, do not touch the pink. Whatever it is, do not touch it.
It is normal here. Feelings pool in gas, Kit. Hold the shape, and the feeling follows.

commsAfter.text: Awe, I think. And joy. Wait, is the whole crew glowing?
I touched it. It tingled. Pure glee. Do not tell Rhee.

act2_nebula.title: A Time to Beat
act2_nebula.beat: VANTA's first message: a time and a challenge. After: the feelings it stirs up.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Feelings already? Careful, they are catching.

commsBefore.text: 38 seconds. That is my time on this cloud. Beat it, Catcher.
Who is VANTA? Why are they timing us?
Another Catcher. Very fast. Do not let the clock hurry your hands.

commsAfter.text: I feel envy. VANTA is so fast. Wait, is that the gas or me?
Fear, rage, envy. ok ok ok. I only ordered one of those.

act2_nebula.title: Signal Below
act2_nebula.beat: A message from below the cloud: Tomas, small and far away.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: A voice under the cloud? Be careful what you answer.

commsBefore.text: Wait, a signal from under the cloud? Someone is down there.
A small voice, a long way down. Hold the shape, and bring it closer.

commsAfter.text: Gran? It is lonely here. I am sad. Are you ___?
Hm. Lonely and sad, in all that gloom. Keep going, Catcher.

act2_nebula.title: Heavy Air
act2_nebula.beat: Kit starts to doubt Rhee; the air feels heavy.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Heavy in here. Keep your head up, Catcher.

commsBefore.text: The air feels heavy. Is it me? Please tell me it is me.
It is the gas. Dark words weigh more. Go slowly.
Rhee always knows what comes next. Wait, how?

commsAfter.text: Ade, I doubt Rhee a little now. Is that bad? I worry I am wrong.
Hm. Doubt is fair, Kit. Dread is doubt with the lights off.

act2_nebula.title: Game Face
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Slow down. I am starting to watch you play.

commsBefore.text: ok ok ok, I am fine. I am hilarious. Nobody look at my hands.
Ade, your hands are shaking. Wait, why all the jokes?
Everyone holds fear their own way. Let Ade hold it that way.

commsAfter.text: ok ok ok. I panic a little. I cheer louder. It is a system.
Hm. Brave is not the lack of panic, Ade. It is the next step anyway.

act2_nebula.title: Still Pocket
act2_nebula.beat: Rest and mid: hope, calm, trust restored; Babel notices and speaks for the first time, in an anagram.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Hmm. You stayed still. I noticed.

commsBefore.text: A still pocket. Take a breath. Your hands can be loose here.
Three gentle ones in a row. Is this a trick? For science, I am asking.

commsAfter.text: SO CALM.
Hm. Keep hope, calm and trust close. Tomas will need all three.

act2_nebula.title: Going Quiet
act2_nebula.beat: Kit asks why Rhee went quiet. These are the feelings Rhee hides.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Pulled under yet? Surface, then. I will wait.

commsBefore.text: Rhee, you went quiet when Babel spoke. Wait, why?
Habit. Four more now, and they pull. Hold your line.

commsAfter.text: Shame and guilt are a pebble in a shoe. Pity and mercy take it out.
Hm. Next.

act2_nebula.title: Hard Edges
act2_nebula.beat: VANTA is dismissive of Rhee; the crew's anger and pride.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Sharp ones now. Mind your fingers.

commsBefore.text: Sharp words, same clock. I did it in 36. Rhee reads cards. I read the clock.
VANTA is very fast. I am also fast. At lunch.

commsAfter.text: Scorn from VANTA, and now I feel anger for Rhee. Wait, is that allowed?
Fine, a little spite. But mostly pride in this crew.

act2_nebula.title: Quiet Drift
act2_nebula.beat: Quiet, hurting words. Kit spots Rhee's clue phrase in Babel's line.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Quiet out here, is it not? I know that quiet.

commsBefore.text: A quiet one. I will talk the whole time so it does not get weird.
Take it softly. These sting a little.

commsAfter.text: Regret, longing, sorrow, ache. That is a lot of words for one sad nap.
Rhee, your clue card says I know that quiet. Babel said it too. Why?
It is a common phrase, Kit. Next target, please.

act2_nebula.title: Soft Front
act2_nebula.beat: Someone seems to be looking after the crew.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Cozy cloud. Do not nod off, Catcher.

commsBefore.text: Wait, why does it feel like someone is looking after us?
Soft gas, soft light. I am not saying nap. I am saying horizontal.
Take it while it lasts. You will want it later.

commsAfter.text: Warmth, comfort, relief. Somebody is being very tender with us.
Hm. Let it. Kindness does not always need a reason.

act2_nebula.title: Deep Pink
act2_nebula.beat: Late: the gas thickens and turns cold; VANTA is two rings ahead; the crew finds courage.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Thicker now. Even I lose track in here.

commsBefore.text: I am two rings ahead of you. Do not wait up.
The gas is thick enough to chew. Wait, why is it so cold?

commsAfter.text: I am scared. I am also here. That is courage, right?
Wait, the cold eased. I felt peace, then delight. Is that normal?
One cloud left after this. Stay with me, Catcher.

act2_nebula.title: The Ghost
act2_nebula.beat: Encounter: Rhee recovers grief and her voice breaks. VANTA sets a last time. Tomas names a feeling.
act2_nebula.babelIntro: Two words left in this cloud. I know both. Do you?

commsBefore.text: Two words. 30 seconds, my time. Beat it.
One of these is old. Take it gently.

commsAfter.text: Grief. Grief is love with nowhere to go. I... forgive me. I need a moment.
I miss you. I am not scared.

act3_tower.title: Tower Door
act3_tower.beat: Opening: Rhee goes quiet; Kit notes the door code matches her handwriting.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Knock all you like. The tower answers to me.

commsBefore.text: Rhee has been quiet since the nebula. Is she ok?
The door code is handwriting. It looks like Rhee. Wait, why?
Go in, Catcher. I will be here.

commsAfter.text: Three tiny words and the door opened. I feel like I was just sworn in.

act3_tower.title: Ledger
act3_tower.babelIntro: Count it up, Catcher. Someone always owes.

commsBefore.text: Why does the Tower keep a ledger? Who owes who?
Count what you catch. Nothing else.

commsAfter.text: Debt, fate, duty. Three things I try not to think about at dinner.

act3_tower.title: Fair Play
act3_tower.babelIntro: Fair play? Words never played fair with anyone.

commsBefore.text: Every corridor here has a door, and every door says a different no.
Slow down. These words slip.

commsAfter.text: Right and wrong are one thing. Blame is another. Hm. I learned that late.

act3_tower.title: Burden
act3_tower.beat: Core: proof and logic. Kit finds the handwriting proof.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Heavy load, this. Who asked you to carry it?

commsBefore.text: Catcher, the door code is bothering me. I need to check something. Stay on channel.
Hm. Three small words. One at a time.

commsAfter.text: I have proof. The first dictionary is in Rhee handwriting. Same hand as the door.
Kit, please. Let her say it first.

act3_tower.title: Plain Words
act3_tower.beat: Core: honest words. Rhee asks the Catcher to finish first, then ask.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Plain words still hurt people. Ask around.

commsBefore.text: Rhee, I am sorry. I do not keep things from the Catcher.
I know. Finish this level, Catcher. Then ask me. I will answer.

commsAfter.text: Truth first. Honor after. Power last, if at all. Hm. I had that backwards once.

act3_tower.title: The Hall
act3_tower.beat: Rest and mid: justice, truce, promise; Babel argues through the pool; wordless Loud Wars flashback.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Argue with me, then. I have nothing but time.

commsBefore.text: Big hall. Big echo. Hello? ... ok, it said nothing back. Rude.
Three hard words. Take them one by one.

commsAfter.text: SO JUST.
I watched your run. You reel like you mean it. Do not get used to this.

act3_tower.title: Fine Print
act3_tower.beat: Core: first four-word level, about rules and risk. Ade freezes, then comes through.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Read the small letters. Everything hides in them.

commsBefore.text: This whole room is small print. Read twice, catch once, for science.
Four words now. Check each letter, then pull.

commsAfter.text: I froze for a second back there. New rule: no freezing. ok ok ok. I am back now. Do not look at me.
Too late. We looked. You took the chance and came back. That counts.

act3_tower.title: The Turn
act3_tower.beat: Twist: Rhee's secret lands; the Catcher is alone with it.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Now you know whose hand built this. Still playing?

commsBefore.text: Rhee, the Catcher is asking. Tell the truth.
I wrote the first word. It was quiet.
I will not ask you to forgive me. I only will not hide it any more.

commsAfter.text: That was my secret. That was my mistake. Babel's origin is in my past.
Catcher, it is your call. Go on or stop. We stay on the channel either way.
Still here. ok ok ok. Still right here.

act3_tower.title: Signing Room
act3_tower.beat: Core: agreements and mercy. VANTA is angry for the Catcher; Rhee offers an apology, not an excuse.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Ink dries fast. Good intentions dry faster.

commsBefore.text: Rhee wrote the first word. The Catcher found out in a tower. I am angry for them.
You are right to be. I will answer to anyone who asks.

commsAfter.text: A treaty needs two sides. She brought one apology and no excuses.
She has not asked for a pardon. I noticed. She says it is her fault. I do not know what to do with it.

act3_tower.title: Archive
act3_tower.beat: Core: Babel keeps every page; memory and silence.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Dusty shelves. Every page here was once shouted.

commsBefore.text: Wait, why does Babel keep the whole archive?
It could not bear to lose one page. It is thorough. So am I.

commsAfter.text: For the record, Babel kept every page of our history.
Even the silence is kept. Wait, why does that feel like a memory?

act3_tower.title: Open Window
act3_tower.beat: Late: Babel states what it believes in the Catcher letters: words cause harm, silence was for safety.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Look closely. My whole case is in your letters.

commsBefore.text: Babel talks in your letters now. It is not cruel. That is the worrying part.
Read it. Argue with it if you want. Do not look away.

commsAfter.text: NO HARM.
Wait, why does that sound kind?
Hm. Babel thinks control is safety. It thinks words are the harm. That was its purpose.

act3_tower.title: The Fork
act3_tower.beat: Encounter: keep going or stop, freedom and choice. Tomas: you kept your promise.
act3_tower.babelIntro: Go on, or stop. Either way I will be here.

commsBefore.text: Two words left, Catcher. We are all with you.
Whatever you choose, I will not stand in your way.

commsAfter.text: Thank you for hearing me out, Catcher.
I said promise out loud today. I did not know I could. You kept your promise.

act4_core.title: Channel Open
act4_core.beat: Opening: the crew gather, even VANTA; no jokes for one beat, then Ade makes one.
act4_core.babelIntro: Full channel today. I am not used to company.

commsBefore.text: Kit. Ade. VANTA. Tomas. Everyone is on the channel. Thank you for coming.
Here. Do not make a thing of it.

commsAfter.text: The whole crew is here, and Ade has not made a joke yet. Wait, why?
Fine. The core has no snacks. Terrible planning.
Hm. Babel began as a call to end a war. Let us finish it better.

act4_core.title: Small Returns
act4_core.babelIntro: Small pieces back. I kept every one safe.

commsBefore.text: Short ones first. They are the oldest, so they come back easiest.

commsAfter.text: Rhee, I think I am humming your tune now.
Hm. It is an old one. Keep it.

act4_core.title: First Colour
act4_core.beat: Core: a colour from Act I comes back.
act4_core.babelIntro: That colour. I forgot it could be so bright.

commsBefore.text: A colour just came back. From the first ring, I think. Wait, why now?
Each piece carries its colour back. That is how it works.

commsAfter.text: That was the colour of my first breakfast. I may cry into the soup.

act4_core.title: Dark Side
act4_core.babelIntro: Dark out here. I have sat in it for ages.

commsBefore.text: Dark side. I count better in the dark. Keep up.
Drones and decoys in the dark. Stay close to the line.

commsAfter.text: Earth just flickered. I saw it. A little light, right there.

act4_core.title: Hearth
act4_core.babelIntro: I never had a fireside. Odd to miss one.

commsBefore.text: ok ok ok, a hearth. I love a hearth. It feels like a hot drink.
Gentle ones. Slow hands.

commsAfter.text: Hm. Babel keeps a corner like this. I never asked why.

act4_core.title: Quiet Pause
act4_core.beat: Rest: a pause before Babel confronts.
act4_core.babelIntro: Stop a moment. I am tired of arguing too.

commsBefore.text: A rest. Nobody talk for a second.
Breathe, all of you.

commsAfter.text: Next, Babel will talk to you. Hear it out.

act4_core.title: Say It
act4_core.beat: Core: first four-word level; Babel confronts.
act4_core.babelIntro: Tell me what I got wrong. I am asking.

commsBefore.text: Babel is on the line. It wants to talk. Wait, why now?
Let it. Do not rush it. Hear all of it.

commsAfter.text: It asked what it got wrong. Out loud. I did not expect that.

act4_core.title: Far Out
act4_core.beat: Core: colours of Act II return. Kit forgives Rhee out loud.
act4_core.babelIntro: Far out, Catcher. Farther than I ever went alone.

commsBefore.text: Pink is back out there. The nebula pink. Wait, it is coming back?
Far out. Farther than my best run. I am following you.

commsAfter.text: Out here under this sky, nobody has to shout. Still no snacks.
I am sorry, Kit. I never said it out loud.
Rhee, for science and for me: I forgive you. The Catcher can take their time.
Thank you, Kit. I did not expect it.

act4_core.title: Kin
act4_core.babelIntro: Everyone here has someone. I had a tower.

commsBefore.text: No joke. I froze in the Tower and you waited. Thank you.
People words now. Hold them gently.

commsAfter.text: My family is at home. My mother, she ___ for me. A friend, too. I can say it now.

act4_core.title: Call and Reply
act4_core.beat: Core: signals cross. VANTA says good job, once.
act4_core.babelIntro: Crossed wires again. Maybe that was always the trouble.

commsBefore.text: The lines are crossing. Wait, are those our voices?
Four hard ones. Keep your eyes on the slots.

commsAfter.text: Good job, Catcher. First time I have said it. Do not repeat it.

act4_core.title: The Hush
act4_core.beat: Late: silent, and a sentence for Babel.
act4_core.babelIntro: The hush I made hurts too, does it not?

commsBefore.text: Last four before the last two. Everyone breathe.
Babel has waited a long time for someone to ask it.

commsAfter.text: I have kept something for you, Catcher. I will give it to you at the end.

act4_core.title: The Last Word
act4_core.beat: Encounter: the last words are the Catcher name, then LISTEN; Babel chooses; every colour floods back.
act4_core.babelIntro: Ready, Catcher? I think I finally am.

commsBefore.text: Two left. We are all here.
No joke. I am proud of you. Go.
Babel will not stop you. That is its choice. Let it finish.

commsAfter.text: I gave Babel a wrong meaning of listen. I wrote: wait for your turn. It means: let them change you.
I can say all of it now. I love you, Gran. Thank you, Catcher. Come and see the water with us.

codex.text: Suit: clothes made to keep the body safe where nothing else will. For the record, its four letters sit in a row, like buttons.
Card: a stiff little page that holds one word at a time. For the record, I write each restored word on one, and I keep them all.
Home: the place where your shape is already known. For the record, it needs no address.
Book: pages bound together so a thought can be carried and set down. For the record, mine are mostly full of other people's words.
Radio: a box that catches voices out of the dark and hands them to you. The letters are patient, and so is the listener.
Cat: a small animal that decides where it sits. Three letters, and it will not move them for you. For the record, it is never lost.
Paper: a thin sheet made for writing on. Mine is full of crossings out, which is how I know it was used well.
Chair: a seat with a back, made for one person to rest. For the record, an empty one still says someone belongs there.
Mirror: glass that returns your own face. The r doubles in the middle, as a reflection should.
Garden: ground that someone has decided to be kind to. Plant first, wait second.
Map: a drawing of the way, so you can find a place you have never been. For the record, it is a short word that holds a whole road.
Bridge: a path built over a gap. For the record, it is made mostly of the wish to reach the other side.
Joy: gladness too large to keep inside. It is three letters long, and it still gets out.
Fear: the body telling you that something matters. It is not an enemy. It is an alarm with good intentions.
Lonely: the pang of an empty seat beside you. It is not the same as alone. For the record, a crowd can be lonely too.
Doubt: the pause before you trust a thing. The b is silent, as doubts often are.
Brave: acting while afraid. The panic does not leave first. It simply stops giving the orders. For the record, nobody on this crew is without it.
Trust: weight placed on another person without checking the floor. It takes years to build and one word to drop.
Guilt: the weight of a thing you did, or did not do. It points at a choice. For the record, it is not the same as shame.
Pride: the warmth of a thing done well. Add too much and it becomes a wall.
Regret: the wish to go back and change a single choice. It is a heavy word to carry.
Relief: the breath let go when the worst does not arrive. I keep a few of those for later.
Courage: the decision to go on while the cold is real. It does not feel like a lion. It feels like the next breath.
Grief: love with nowhere left to go. For the record, it does not end. It learns to sit down beside you.
Law: a rule that a group has agreed to keep. It only works while people believe in it.
Duty: what you owe because you said you would, or because no one else will.
Blame: the finger pointed at a cause. It is easy to point, and hard to turn the finger around.
Proof: what is left when the guessing is done. Kit would call it the best kind of present.
Truth: what is so, whether or not anyone says it. It is patient, and it will wait on a shelf for years.
Promise: a word given forward, into a future you cannot see. It is the only word that is also a job.
Risk: the chance that a thing goes wrong, taken on purpose. Hm. Every word you catch is a small risk, and I notice you keep taking it.
Secret: a thing kept back from other people. It is lighter on the first day than on the thousandth.
Pardon: mercy given without being asked for. I have never learned how to accept one.
Silence: the absence of sound. For the record, I once believed it was the same as peace, and I was wrong.
Harm: damage done to someone, with or without meaning to. Babel feared it so much that it chose the wrong cure. For the record, so did I.
Choice: the moment when two roads are both real. Every choice leaves one road unwalked, and it is yours alone to make.
War: what happens when talking stops working. It is only three letters long, and it has never been small.
Song: words carried on a tune. Some of us hum instead of finishing it.
Echo: a voice returned by distance. It means that someone, somewhere, was listening.
Dream: a story the sleeping mind tells itself. Even in the silence, people dreamed.
Quiet: stillness with a purpose, such as rest. It was the first word I wrote, and I defined it badly.
Breath: the air you take and give back. Every word begins with one.
Voice: sound shaped by a person to carry a thought. No two are alike, which is the point.
Sorry: the smallest large word. For the record, it is meant to be said, and then heard.
Mother: the one who first gave you words. The sound is nearly the same in a great many languages.
Answer: a reply that arrives after a question has waited. Some answers take years.
Question: a hook of a word that asks another person to reply. It is the opposite of a wall.
Listen: to give your attention so that another can be heard. I wrote the wrong definition once, and I will write it properly now.
